about: Recorded classical music for the app (owner 2026-10-08: 'at minimum the classical music'). tools/music/fetch_classical.py looks each piece up on Wikimedia Commons, keeps only Public Domain / CC0 / CC BY(-SA) recordings by real performers (no MIDI or synth renderings), and writes audio/music/. Compositions are all long out of copyright; the license that matters is the RECORDING's, and the script checks it per file. moods: piano = calm rooms (Conservator, Midnight Gallery, Private Bank, Fireside, Alchemist, Observatory, Library at closing, Cafe, Coastal reading room); orchestra = grand rooms (Midnight vault, Roman Treasury, Hoard Hall, Captain's Cabin). 2026-10-09: exact picks + reviewed credits from Grok's music check (music_grok_20261008-1107.json); `hold` parks a piece, `credit` fixes the license line Commons gets wrong (the composition's PD template comes first).
